name: AP Physics C: Mechanics
description: Scorpio's roadmap through the seven AP Physics C: Mechanics units, with calculus throughout. The sets are planned; their problems are not written yet.

sets.title: Vectors and the calculus of motion
sets.description: Vector components, and velocity and acceleration as derivatives and integrals.

sets.title: Representing motion
sets.description: Motion graphs and equations for constant and changing acceleration.

sets.title: Reference frames and relative motion
sets.description: Velocities measured from frames that move relative to each other.

sets.title: Motion in two and three dimensions
sets.description: Projectiles and vector kinematics with independent components.

sets.title: Systems, center of mass and free-body diagrams
sets.description: Choosing a system, locating its center of mass and drawing its forces.

sets.title: Newton's laws
sets.description: Third-law pairs, equilibrium and net force with acceleration.

sets.title: Gravity, friction and springs
sets.description: Universal gravitation, friction models and Hooke's law.

sets.title: Drag and circular motion
sets.description: Velocity-dependent resistive forces, terminal velocity and centripetal acceleration.

sets.title: Kinetic energy and work
sets.description: Work as an integral of force and the work-energy theorem.

sets.title: Potential energy
sets.description: Conservative forces and potential energy functions U(x).

sets.title: Conservation of energy
sets.description: Energy accounting with and without nonconservative forces.

sets.title: Power
sets.description: Rate of energy transfer, including P = F dot v.

sets.title: Momentum of objects and systems
sets.description: Momentum as a vector for single objects and systems.

sets.title: Impulse
sets.description: Impulse as the integral of force over time and force-time graphs.

sets.title: Conservation of momentum
sets.description: Isolated systems, center-of-mass velocity and explosions.

sets.title: Collisions
sets.description: Elastic and inelastic collisions in one and two dimensions.

sets.title: Rotational kinematics
sets.description: Angular quantities with calculus, and their link to linear motion.

sets.title: Torque
sets.description: Torque as a cross product: lever arms and direction.

sets.title: Rotational inertia and equilibrium
sets.description: Moments of inertia by integration, the parallel-axis theorem and balanced torques.

sets.title: Newton's second law for rotation
sets.description: Net torque and angular acceleration, with translation.

sets.title: Rotational kinetic energy and work
sets.description: Energy of rotation and work done by torques.

sets.title: Angular momentum and angular impulse
sets.description: Angular momentum of particles and rigid bodies and how torque changes it.

sets.title: Conservation of angular momentum
sets.description: Systems with no net external torque.

sets.title: Rolling and orbits
sets.description: Rolling with and without slipping, satellite energy and escape speed.

sets.title: Restoring forces and the SHM equation
sets.description: Forces proportional to displacement and the differential equation they give.

sets.title: Period and frequency
sets.description: What sets the period of springs and other oscillators.

sets.title: Analysing SHM
sets.description: Sinusoidal position, velocity and acceleration, amplitude and phase.

sets.title: Energy and pendulums
sets.description: Energy over a cycle, and simple and physical pendulums.
